purpose: Estimate the density of the experimental steel (austenite, ρ_γ) as a function of its alloying element contents, using the equation proposed by Kim et al. [19].
applicability_conditions: Empirical equation proposed by Kim et al. [19] for estimating the density of the experimental steel; applied to the present experimental steel, giving an estimated density of 7.078 g/cm³.

symbols.meaning: Empirical constant coefficient in the density equation for austenite (intercept)
Empirical constant coefficient of the Al% term
Empirical constant coefficient of the C% term
Empirical constant coefficient of the Mn% term

unmapped: The equation is referenced as equation (1), proposed by Kim et al. [19].
The estimated density from this equation is 7.078 g/cm³, while the measured density is 7.114 g/cm³.
